product_one_liner.value: Qubrid AI provides GPU cloud infrastructure and a unified inference API so developers, researchers, startups and enterprises can build, deploy and scale AI workloads.

named_customers.notes: CBIT is a documented platform user in a case study; Lern.Law provides a testimonial describing its use of Qubrid support and platform.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 16 employees as of 2026; the company profile reports 19.

founded_year.notes: The company profile gives 2024. Some databases give 2023, when the predecessor Qubrid platform was launched by Dihuni.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed blog contains model guides, benchmarks and product announcements; the product posts are attributed to Qubrid Team, not identified engineers, and do not establish two engineer-authored accounts of how the product is built.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers site lists Full Stack AI Engineer, a remote full-time role.

model_provider.value: DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax and NVIDIA Nemotron
model_provider.notes: Qubrid hosts or makes these model families available through its platform; this does not imply that customer inputs are sent to each model developer.

compliance_certs.notes: The documentation claims its data centers are HIPAA compliant and “SOC Type II”; the hosting page says “SOC Type 2.” These are facility-level claims, not evidence of a company-wide audit. SOC 2 is omitted because the cited pages do not explicitly name SOC 2.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists a completed angel round on June 14, 2024 without an amount, so amount_usd is omitted. Funding records conflict: VCBacked gives $250,000 pre-seed in April 2024; Premier Alternatives claims a $25 million September 2026 seed, while PitchBook labels that seed upcoming. No completed 2026 round was independently established.

raised_18mo.notes: For May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026, the completed-round history in PitchBook ends in June 2024 and the $25 million seed is marked upcoming. Premier Alternatives contradicts this with a September 2026 completion claim and internally inconsistent total funding; that claim was not corroborated by a dated announcement or filing.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers page lists GPU Kubernetes Cluster Engineer and Full Stack AI Engineer, neither a qualifying sales title.

launched_6mo.notes: Within May 9–November 9, 2026, Qubrid announced Model Comparison on June 11 and its Dify Marketplace integration on June 30.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete leadership roster with start dates was available to establish a negative for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026; no qualifying dated join or departure was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A third-party Qubrid job listing explicitly says “Maintain and update CRM (HubSpot/Zoho)”; this is a hiring signal, not independently verified deployment.
